verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?
verdicts.designer_notes: No designer answer for this target — the vision routine verifies it by tracing cables across photos with 'Cable Routing', 'Equipment Location', 'Meter Box' and similar captions on pages 4+.
verdicts.photo_observation: Page 5 ('Inverter, ACDB, and DCDB location'): Both photos show a single identified enclosure box on an exterior wall with annotation 'Inverter, ACDB, DCDB will be fixed in this box'; a second photo labels a position 'below the corrugated sheet'. All three equipment items are co-located in one box — no orphan DCDB or ACDB end. Page 6 ('AC, DC earthing cable & LA cable routing'): Aerial rooftop photo with colored overlay lines showing the AC cable path from the inverter/ACDB box running along the south parapet wall toward the solar meter cubicle; caption explicitly states this route. DC cable route from panels to DCDB is visible only as overhead colored lines in this aerial view, not as a close-up photo. Page 7 ('AC cable, AC, DC earthing cable & LA cable routing'): Three photos with pink, green, and yellow colored lines tracing cables running (a) along the underside of a corrugated roof ceiling, (b) vertically down an exterior wall, and (c) arriving at the meter/panel area — the run down the building facade is documented with surface-mounted routing. Page 8 ('AC cable routing and meter box location'): Left photo shows the exterior wall with the solar meter box explicitly labelled and the AC cable arriving at it; right photo shows the open main distribution panel with multiple MCBs and the meter — the terminal point of the AC circuit is documented. Page 9 ('AC, DC and LA earthing pit location'): Three coloured markers identify separate DC Earthing, LA Earthing, and AC Earthing pit positions in the side-yard near the meter area — all three pit positions account for the earthing cable ends. Page 10 ('Lighting arrestor location'): LA position near the water tank is photographed; ladder access to rooftop also visible. Page 11 (Observations): Written confirmation of cable lengths — DC 15m (RED + BLACK), AC 30m, DC Earthing 35m, AC Earthing 35m, LA 40m — all consistent with the routed distances visible in photos. No unexplained mid-run size changes are mentioned or visible. No orphan cable ends are visible in any photo. Conduit/surface clamping is implied by the overlay traces running along wall and ceiling surfaces, but explicit conduit fittings are not distinctly visible at this photo resolution.
verdicts.rationale: The complete cable routing chain is documented across pages 5–10: Inverter, ACDB, and DCDB are co-located in one box (page 5), eliminating any internal orphan ends; the AC run from that box along the south parapet wall to the solar meter cubicle is shown via colored overlays on pages 6–7 and confirmed with a labelled photo on page 8; the main panel is photographed open alongside the solar meter (page 8); all three earthing pit endpoints (DC, LA, AC) are identified on page 9; and the Observations text (page 11) reconciles all cable lengths consistently. The one gap is that the DC cable run from the rooftop panels down to the DCDB is only shown in a low-resolution aerial overview (page 6) without a close-up conduit/clipping photo — hence medium rather than high confidence — but no contradiction or orphan end is present. Overall the routing story is coherent and continuous.
